name: Triveni Sangam
alt: Aerial view of Triveni Sangam in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, India
description: Morning aerial view of the Ganga and Yamuna meeting at Triveni Sangam, their different water colours forming a seam, with wooden boats gathered at the confluence and Prayagraj hazy beyond.
caption: Triveni Sangam viewed from above, where the Ganga, Yamuna and mythical Saraswati are traditionally believed to meet.

name: Jaisalmer Fort
alt: Aerial view of Jaisalmer Fort in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, India
description: Late-afternoon aerial view of Jaisalmer Fort's yellow sandstone walls and rounded bastions on Trikuta Hill, with houses packed inside and the flat Thar Desert reaching a hazy horizon.
caption: Jaisalmer Fort, the 'Golden Fort', is one of the world's few living forts, with homes, shops and temples still inside its sandstone walls.

name: Pangong Lake
alt: Aerial view of Pangong Lake in Ladakh, India
description: Mid-morning aerial view along Pangong Lake, its water shifting from turquoise shallows to deep blue between bare brown Ladakhi mountains, with a dirt road and small village on the shore.
caption: Pangong Lake, at about 4,200 m in Ladakh, shifts through shades of blue and stretches across the border into Tibet.
